title: 地面转折处
standfirst: 岩壁间，路反复折返。人、树与车，为地面的起伏留下尺度。
standfirstEn: A path doubles back between rock walls. People, trees and cars give scale to the changing ground.
introduction: 蒸汽从地面升起，观看的人排成一道细线。转到近处，橙色表面显出孔洞；再抬起眼睛，石柱、岩壁与公路又把尺度拉开。这些照片关心地面如何从眼前的纹理，变成围绕身体的环境。
从石面到步径，再到水边，这组照片在几种距离之间展开。人和车时而可以辨认，时而只剩一小点；一道弯曲的线，也可能是小径、浪边，或水上的船迹。
introductionEn: Steam rises from the ground; the people watching it form a fine line. Closer in, hollows appear in an orange surface. Looking up again, columns, rock walls and roads stretch the scale. These photographs follow the ground as it changes from a texture before the eye into an environment around the body.

From stone to paths and then to water, the sequence moves through several distances. People and cars can be recognisable, or reduced to points. A bending line may belong to a footpath, the edge of a wave, or a boat’s wake.

chapters.title: 表面与缝隙
chapters.text: 灰白、橙色与深蓝相遇，近处的地面显出孔洞和细纹。距离逐渐拉开，纹理变成石柱、岩岸与洞口，空隙也有了大小。
chapters.textEn: Pale grey, orange and deep blue meet as hollows and fine textures appear nearby. As the distance opens, textures become columns, rocky shores and a cave mouth. Gaps acquire a scale of their own.

chapters.title: 路径的宽度
chapters.text: 山谷里、水边，都有一条弯路。路旁细小的车辆和崖缘坐着的人，让景物之间的距离有了身体的尺度。
chapters.textEn: A road bends through a canyon; another follows water. Small vehicles and people seated at an edge bring the distances within the landscape back to the scale of the body.

chapters.title: 水际
chapters.text: 漂木停在沙面，白色泡沫抵达岸边。俯看的海岸展开之后，山的远近在雾里分出层次，船留下更细的一道横线。
chapters.textEn: Driftwood rests on sand and white foam reaches the shore. After the coast opens beneath an elevated view, mist separates the layers of hills and a boat leaves a finer horizontal line.
